result.instructions: Tools for Deputy, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Deputy data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run deputy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run deputy_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run deputy_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. deputy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: deputy_whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return the Deputy user the token belongs to — name, employee id, company and permissions. A cheap way to confirm DEPUTY_INSTALL and the token are right. Deputy: GET /api/v1/me.

tools.name: deputy_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the install's locations (workplaces). Deputy calls a location a Company; its Id is what other tools take as location_id. Deputy: GET /api/v1/resource/Company.

tools.name: deputy_list_areas
tools.title: List areas
tools.description: List areas (Deputy OperationalUnits — the rosterable sections of a location, e.g. Kitchen, Front of house). Shifts and timesheets belong to an area. Optionally only one location's areas. Deputy: GET /api/v1/resource/OperationalUnit, or POST .../OperationalUnit/QUERY when filtered.

location_id.description: Only areas of this location (Company id).

start.description: Pagination offset (0-based). Pass the previous page's next_start.

tools.name: deputy_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: Search employees by name, location or active status. Returns Id, DisplayName, Company (main location), Active, StartDate, Role and more. Deputy: POST /api/v1/resource/Employee/QUERY.

name_contains.description: Only employees whose DisplayName contains this text.

location_id.description: Only employees whose main location is this Company id.

active.description: true = current staff only; false = terminated/inactive only.

start.description: Pagination offset (0-based). Pass the previous page's next_start.

tools.name: deputy_get_employee
tools.title: Get one employee
tools.description: Fetch one employee's details as a supervisor sees them — contact, locations, role and employment. Deputy: GET /api/v1/supervise/employee/{id}.

tools.name: deputy_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: Search the roster (scheduled shifts) by time window, employee, area, and published/open state. Each record has StartTime/EndTime (unix), StartTimeLocalized, Employee (0 or null when open), OperationalUnit (area), Published, Open, Cost and _DPMetaData with names. Deputy: POST /api/v1/resource/Roster/QUERY.

from.description: Only shifts starting at or after this time: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 date/datetime (include an offset for local times).

to.description: Only shifts starting at or before this time: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 date/datetime (include an offset for local times).

area_id.description: Only shifts in this area (OperationalUnit id).

published.description: true = published only; false = drafts only.

start.description: Pagination offset (0-based). Pass the previous page's next_start.

tools.name: deputy_get_shift
tools.title: Get one shift
tools.description: Fetch one shift (Roster record) by id. Deputy: GET /api/v1/resource/Roster/{id}.

tools.name: deputy_list_timesheets
tools.title: List timesheets
tools.description: Search timesheets (actual worked time) by time window, employee, area and approval state. Each record has StartTime/EndTime (unix; EndTime null while in progress), TotalTime (hours), Cost, TimeApproved, PayRuleApproved, IsInProgress, IsLeave, Roster (linked shift) and Exported. Deputy: POST /api/v1/resource/Timesheet/QUERY.

from.description: Only timesheets starting at or after this time: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 date/datetime (include an offset for local times).

to.description: Only timesheets starting at or before this time: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 date/datetime (include an offset for local times).

area_id.description: Only timesheets in this area (OperationalUnit id).

time_approved.description: Filter on TimeApproved (supervisor approved the times).

pay_approved.description: Filter on PayRuleApproved (approved for payroll export).

in_progress.description: true = only people currently on the clock.

start.description: Pagination offset (0-based). Pass the previous page's next_start.

tools.name: deputy_get_timesheet
tools.title: Get one timesheet
tools.description: Fetch one timesheet's full details, including breaks and approval state. Deputy: GET /api/v1/supervise/timesheet/{id}/details.

tools.name: deputy_list_leave
tools.title: List leave requests
tools.description: Search leave requests by employee, location, status and time window. Status: 0 awaiting approval, 1 approved, 2 declined, 3 cancelled, 4 date approved without pay, 5 pay approved without date. Start/End are unix; LeaveRule is the leave type id. Deputy: POST /api/v1/resource/Leave/QUERY.

location_id.description: Only leave against this location (Company id).

from.description: Only leave starting at or after this time: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 date/datetime (include an offset for local times).

to.description: Only leave starting at or before this time: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 date/datetime (include an offset for local times).

start.description: Pagination offset (0-based). Pass the previous page's next_start.

tools.name: deputy_get_employee_unavailability
tools.title: Get an employee's unavailability
tools.description: List the times one employee has marked themselves (or been marked) unavailable to work — check before rostering them. Deputy: GET /api/v1/supervise/unavail/{employeeId}.

tools.name: deputy_query_resource
tools.title: Query any Deputy resource
tools.description: Run a Resource API search on any business object (leave types, pay rules, public holidays, memos, events, shift templates, pay lines, availability, sales data, …). `search` is Deputy's clause map, e.g. {"s1":{"field":"Employee","data":12,"type":"eq"}}; operators: eq ne gt lt ge le is 'is not' in 'not in' starts contains. Use deputy_describe_resource to see an object's fields and joins. Read-only. Deputy: POST /api/v1/resource/{Object}/QUERY.

object.description: Resource API object. Deputy names: Company = location, OperationalUnit = area, Roster = shift, LeaveRules = leave types, TimesheetPayReturn = approved pay lines.

search.description: Clauses keyed by any id (s1, s2, …). All must match.

field.description: Field name, e.g. Employee, Date, StartTime.

data.description: Comparison value; type depends on the field.

join.description: Related objects to expand inline, e.g. ["TimesheetObject"] on TimesheetPayReturn.

start.description: Pagination offset (0-based). Pass the previous page's next_start.

tools.name: deputy_describe_resource
tools.title: Describe a Deputy resource
tools.description: Return a Resource API object's field list, field types and joinable associations — what deputy_query_resource can filter, sort and join on. Deputy: GET /api/v1/resource/{Object}/INFO.

object.description: Resource API object. Deputy names: Company = location, OperationalUnit = area, Roster = shift, LeaveRules = leave types, TimesheetPayReturn = approved pay lines.

tools.name: deputy_create_shift
tools.title: Create a shift
tools.description: Add a shift to the roster, assigned to an employee or left open. Created as a DRAFT unless publish is true (publishing can notify the employee). Deputy returns an empty 200 on success — use deputy_list_shifts to find the new shift's id. Deputy: POST /api/v1/supervise/roster.

start_time.description: Shift start: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

end_time.description: Shift end: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

area_id.description: Area (OperationalUnit id) the shift is for.

employee_id.description: Employee to put on the shift. Omit (and set open: true) for an unfilled shift.

open.description: Show the shift as open for employees to claim.

publish.description: Publish now. Publishing can notify the employee. Default false (draft).

mealbreak_minutes.description: Unpaid meal break length in minutes.

force_overwrite.description: Overwrite a clashing shift for the same employee. Default false.

tools.name: deputy_update_shift
tools.title: Update a shift
tools.description: Change an existing shift's times, area, employee, break or comment. Send the full intended shift (same fields as create) — Deputy's update is the add call with the shift id. Deputy: POST /api/v1/supervise/roster with intRosterId.

start_time.description: Shift start: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

end_time.description: Shift end: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

area_id.description: Area (OperationalUnit id) the shift is for.

employee_id.description: Employee to put on the shift. Omit (and set open: true) for an unfilled shift.

open.description: Show the shift as open for employees to claim.

publish.description: Publish now. Publishing can notify the employee. Default false (draft).

mealbreak_minutes.description: Unpaid meal break length in minutes.

force_overwrite.description: Overwrite a clashing shift for the same employee. Default false.

tools.name: deputy_publish_shifts
tools.title: Publish shifts
tools.description: Publish draft shifts so employees see them, choosing how they are notified: 1 SMS and email, 2 SMS, 3 email, 4 no notification, 5 confirmation required. Only the listed shift ids are published. Deputy: POST /api/v1/supervise/roster/publish.

notify_mode.description: 1 SMS+email, 2 SMS, 3 email, 4 none, 5 confirmation required.

tools.name: deputy_create_leave_request
tools.title: Create a leave request
tools.description: Add a leave request for an employee. By default it waits for manager approval (status 0); pass status 1 only when your system is the source of truth and the leave is already approved. Deputy tracks leave in hours, so give exact start and end times. Find leave type ids with deputy_query_resource on LeaveRules. Deputy: POST /api/v1/resource/Leave.

leave_rule_id.description: Leave type (LeaveRules id), e.g. annual leave.

location_id.description: Location (Company id) the leave is recorded against.

start_time.description: Leave start: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

end_time.description: Leave end: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

comment.description: The employee's note to the manager.

tools.name: deputy_add_unavailability
tools.title: Add unavailability for an employee
tools.description: Record a time an employee cannot work (one-off, or recurring with an RFC 5545-style rule such as FREQ WEEKLY, INTERVAL 1, BYDAY MO). Auto-scheduling then skips them. Deputy: POST /api/v1/supervise/unavail.

start_time.description: Unavailability start: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

end_time.description: Unavailability end: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

comment.description: Note the manager sees. Default empty.

tools.name: deputy_create_memo
tools.title: Post a memo
tools.description: Post a memo to a location's news feed, optionally requiring staff to confirm they read it, or targeted to specific locations or users. Visible to staff immediately. Deputy: PUT /api/v1/supervise/memo.

require_confirm.description: Ask staff to confirm they have read it. Default false.

user_ids.description: Only these USER ids (not employee ids) receive it.

tools.name: deputy_update_timesheet
tools.title: Update a timesheet
tools.description: Correct an existing timesheet's start/end time, area, meal break or supervisor comment. Times cannot be in the future. Deputy: POST /api/v1/supervise/timesheet/update.

start_time.description: Timesheet start: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

end_time.description: Timesheet end: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

area_id.description: Area (OperationalUnit id) the time was worked in.

tools.name: deputy_approve_timesheet
tools.title: Approve a timesheet
tools.description: Approve one timesheet's times as a supervisor. Approved timesheets flow toward payroll export, so check it first with deputy_get_timesheet. Deputy: POST /api/v1/supervise/timesheet/approve.
